title: Shell bursts, fires and tracers light the smoke
summary: At night, shell bursts light their smoke from inside, fires and muzzle flashes light the smoke drifting past them, and tracers leave a faint glowing streak in the haze and dust.
stage: Game scenarios off-screen at night: --scenario=attack with --fx-demo and --shot-demo (controlled bursts and machine-gun tracers across the field), --scenario=roster (a battle), frozen and flipped with FL_DEBUG_AIR_FLIP + FL_DEBUG_AIR_FLIP_LIGHTS for the stills; the clip is two matched live runs, the second with FL_DEBUG_AIR_LIGHTS_OFF for the before.
rationale: The change is light that comes and goes with each burst, so a short matched before/after clip shows it best; one combined still sheet holds the same frozen moments with the lights off and on, including the browser renderer, for a quick comparison.
source_ref: 9ffb6149 on dines/battle-lights-in-smoke (Godot 4.7.2, Windows, RTX 3090). Frames from the movie writer (MJPEG), composed with PIL; WebM: VP9 via Playwright's ffmpeg.
